summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running code or tests. Changed: src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (new: Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs), src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py (single Text output, clickable_ranges, click spans last), src/textual/renderables/opacity.py (style-preserving blend), docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, and tests in tests/test_tabs.py, tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py. Nothing committed. Deviations: the bar position uses displayed-tab indices so duplicate names sit under the correct tab; search only matches single-character keys; a Tab name is replaced by its label only when None. Layout resolver needed no change since its Edge protocol already has size, min_size and fraction. Known edge case: an empty label gets a flexible width in the resolver. Expected test values were derived by hand and still need a real test run.
